text: Researchers observed a Pokémon sleeping through an entire movie before claiming it remained awake.
Field teams report a crowned silhouette that grows more energetic after midnight.
A small Pokémon was spotted guarding a music player. It refused to let anyone else choose the next song.
Hikers describe a booming bassline echoing between the mountains, perfectly matched to their mood.
Wide, glowing eyes were seen watching a screen long after the credits ended. The next episode began automatically.
Late-night travellers report a fiery glow drifting between cinemas: "just one more," it seemed to say.
In the northern forest, one of the pine trees appears to wander a little each night.
A ribboned box was found under a tree. It wiggled when the researchers tried to peek inside.
Windowsills across the region glow softly on the longest nights, even where no candles were lit.
Sleigh tracks were found on a rooftop with no sleigh, no reindeer, and no footprints leading away.
Old Winterveil songs describe a guardian who drapes the land in snow so everyone stays close to home.
A faint melody has been recorded on Christmas Day only. No one has found its source… yet.
